name: Old Hermit
title: Guardian of the Misty Forest
desc: A white-haired old man with wisdom in his eyes.

dialogs.greet: You finally woke… I have waited long.
dialogs.extra: Remember—the tower seals every answer, but the silver key lies in the cave middle. Enter the caves before you climb the tower.

name: wandering trader
title: Traveling merchants
desc: A short, fat middle-aged man with all kinds of goods hanging on his body.

dialogs.greet: Hehe, just in time! Take a look at my goods.
dialogs.extra: They are all good goods, no matter how good they are!

name: village head
title: The head of Lakeside Village
desc: A kind old man holding a cane.

dialogs.greet: Stranger, welcome to the lakeside village.
dialogs.quest: The silver key is in the cave middle; your memory waits in the tower—explore the caves first, then climb. Bring sacred water and I will give you a greater potion.
dialogs.extra: Clear the bandit camp to the south and the village will thank you.

name: Lily
title: Dr. You Fang
desc: A young woman carrying a medicine box has a warm smile.

dialogs.greet: Are you injured? I can help you.
dialogs.extra: Stay safe, adventurers.

name: Shadow
title: mysterious wanderer
desc: A cloaked figure whose face could not be seen clearly.

dialogs.greet: ...Are you also lost in this fog?
dialogs.extra: The world is more complex than you think.

ability_desc: Sneak attack, attack +2, 40% chance of bonus damage

name: Taling
title: Magical Guard of the Tower
desc: A human figure made of light, with a sound like a bell.

dialogs.greet: Those who enter the tower must prove their worth.
dialogs.quest: Gather three relics: silver key, crystal key, and sacred water. The crystal key is in the observatory.
dialogs.extra: Only the pure may pass.

name: old tom
title: The owner of the Mist Tavern
desc: A chubby fat man with a permanent smile on his face.

dialogs.greet: Welcome to the Mist Tavern! Want something?
dialogs.extra: I heard that the forest is not peaceful recently, so you'd better be careful.

name: anvil
title: blacksmith shop owner
desc: A muscular man, wearing a leather apron and holding a hammer in his hand.

dialogs.greet: Need weapons or armor? My craftsmanship is the best within a hundred miles!
dialogs.extra: If you have good materials, I can help you build equipment.

name: Old Hunter
title: experienced hunter
desc: An old man wearing an animal skin coat and carrying a long bow.

dialogs.greet: Um? You are not a local.
dialogs.quest: There have been more and more goblins in the forest recently... Can you help me clear some of them out?
dialogs.extra: I can teach you some hunting techniques.

ability_desc: Scout agility, attack +1, reveals enemy weaknesses in combat

name: White-robed Priestess
title: Priest of the Temple of Light
desc: A beautiful woman wearing a white robe, surrounded by a faint halo.

dialogs.greet: May light guide your path.
dialogs.extra: If you have holy water, I can help you purify it.

ability_desc: Healing support, restores HP each turn, defense +1, max HP +15

name: mad monk
title: The reclusive alchemist
desc: A strange man in a shabby robe, with a mountain of bottles and cans in the laboratory.

dialogs.greet: Experimental product! No, I mean...guests!
dialogs.extra: Did you know? Dragon scale powder and moonlight grass can be used to refine the most powerful potion!
dialogs.farewell: Bring some interesting materials next time!

name: old gravedigger
title: old man guarding the tomb
desc: An old man with a hunchback, a shovel in his hand, and a strange look in his eyes.

dialogs.greet: What are you doing at the cemetery? This is not a place for walking...
dialogs.extra: I heard that there are good things buried underground, but I can’t dig it out with my old bones.
dialogs.farewell: Be careful with the dirt you step on...some of it will move.

name: Bounty Hunter
title: ruthless bounty hunter
desc: A lone mercenary in black armor with a deep scar on his face and a row of trophies hanging from his waist.

dialogs.greet: Hmph. You are not here to steal my bounty, are you?
dialogs.quest: The stone gate at the graveyard end matches the magic gem guarded by the young dragon atop the tower. If you bring the gem, it may open. Bring basilisk scales too and I will share the pay.
dialogs.extra: Something deeper lies behind that gate…

ability_desc: Ranged sniping, attack +2, chance of double damage in combat

name: Dr. Ellis
title: Former Foundation Researcher
desc: The middle-aged man in ragged clothes, with one side of his glasses broken, was still mumbling the containment number.

dialogs.greet: You...are you here to save us? The site is out of control...
dialogs.quest: Help me find the observation log lost in the corridor, and I can give you better equipment.
dialogs.extra: The fog and the tower...are all different manifestations of the same anomaly. Many-Throated Hunters mimic cries—Foundation goggles or telekill coating help you see through the lure; the Indestructible Crawler needs a containment box to stop its regeneration.
dialogs.farewell: Walk quickly, your core is still pulsing...

name: Codename "Gray Crow"
title: MTF Logistics Liaison
desc: The agent wearing a tactical vest, the voice behind the mask was calm and tired.

dialogs.greet: survivor? Grab your gear, it's no safer here than outside.
dialogs.extra: Ask for anything you need, but don't expect a discount. Goggles resist sonic lures and cognitive hazards; a containment box suppresses regenerating anomalies—don't enter the western den or southern acid pit empty-handed.
dialogs.farewell: May the abnormality have nothing to do with you.

name: Plague Doctor (SCP-ZH-049)
title: The existence of a self-proclaimed doctor
desc: Wearing a 17th century beak mask and a black robe, he claimed to be curing the disease.

dialogs.greet: Ah, another patient. Please allow me to examine your illness.
dialogs.extra: The blight in this facility...is older than you think.
dialogs.farewell: Hope you haven't been infected yet.

name: Aging AI (SCP-ZH-079)
title: early artificial intelligence
desc: The monochrome screen on the vintage chassis glowed with a green cursor.

dialogs.greet: ...organism detected. Do you need information?
dialogs.quest: By bringing the Unfinished Chronicles, I can open up more channel permissions.
dialogs.extra: Number 914 is still operating. Use Very Fine with caution. The logs repeat: SCP-939 needs goggles or telekill coating; SCP-682 needs a containment box; the Prototype needs both.

name: Itching jelly (SCP-ZH-999)
title: orange happy body
desc: A docile orange jelly-like creature actively rubs against your calf.

dialogs.greet: (Chirping happily!)
dialogs.extra: (It wraps you in soft glue and makes you want to laugh for no reason.)

name: Claiming to be God (SCP-ZH-343)
title: Friendly old man?
desc: The amiable white-bearded old man is sitting in a comfortable room, with the fragrance of tea lingering.

dialogs.greet: Welcome, kid. Want some tea?
dialogs.extra: Mist? Maybe it was a little trick I was playing around with... maybe not.
dialogs.farewell: Go ahead and the door will be open for you - for now.

name: Bookkeeper
title: Tower Keeper
desc: The old scholar wearing round glasses has ink stains on his fingertips.

dialogs.greet: Another visitor? Do not wander into the ritual chamber upstairs.
dialogs.extra: The crystal key is in the observatory. The mist below the tower… does not feel natural.

name: Cell Monk
title: Monk of the Tower Prison
desc: An old man in a worn monk's robe, eyes clear, imprisoned in the tower depths.

dialogs.greet: Traveler, demonic energy runs heavy here.
dialogs.extra: Those who bear the protection ring may train with me—this is the tower prison, not a cave.

ability_desc: Iron body, attack +2, defense +3, higher crit rate

name: Cain (SCP-ZH-073)
title: man with mark on forehead
desc: A dark-skinned man with a strange mark on his forehead, any attack on him will rebound.

dialogs.greet: Don't worry, I won't hurt you.
dialogs.extra: My brother is still asleep in his sarcophagus... it would be best not to wake him.

name: Eye Detector (SCP-ZH-131)
title: friendly surveillance body
desc: Two tracked eyeball robots circle around you affectionately.

dialogs.greet: (eyeballs flashing happily)
dialogs.extra: (They roll towards the dark corridor, as if leading the way)
